name: CI Gates
rationale: Turns architecture guidance into review gates that can stop new generated monolith debt.

sources.label: architect-mcp review gate policy
sources.note: New high-confidence architecture errors should fail review instead of being hidden by broad baselines.

rules: Architecture review should run after scaffolding and large generated changes.
CI mode should fail on new error findings.
Baselines require specific paths/messages for high-confidence errors.
reviewQuestions: Which findings should block new generated work?
